method.range_rationale: The death certificate records 'Age 68' at 2019-06-21, which arithmetically implies birth between 1950-06-22 and 1951-06-21. The scan deliberately spans a WIDER window (1949-1952) than that implication so the astrological scan is not confined by the documentary prior.
method.critical_caveat: These are traditional interpretive relationships, not a dating algorithm. A high score means closer CORRESPONDENCE with the descendant charts on these specific relationships; it is not evidence of a birth date.
